card: Removes dead code, unused helper methods, obsolete constants, and template instantiations across 35 files in the Qt GUI, script, netbase, policy, and kernel components. Enables the -Wunused-macros and -Wunused-template compiler warnings in CMake. The primary payoff is clearing compiler warnings needed to unblock enabling broader -Wunused flags in #36167.
changed_since_previous: No changes to the patch content or approach; the full diff is now provided.
evidence: Author states this is 'Part of #36167' ([RFC] Enable `-Wunused`).
Individual commit messages identify specific PRs that removed callers (e.g., 'The capnp method and its test were removed in 6077157531' and 'The last caller (dumpwallet) was removed in 8ede6dea0c').
problem: Stale helper functions, unused constants, and template instantiations remain in headers and source files after their call sites have been refactored or deleted. These lingering declarations add maintenance clutter and trigger warnings that prevent enabling compiler warning flags like -Wunused-macros and -Wunused-template.

risk.why: Mistakenly deleting code that is actually still referenced would cause compile-time build failures rather than silent runtime consensus or safety bugs.

scope_notes: A mechanical collection of 27 commits removing unused code across 35 files, concluding with compiler warning flag additions in CMakeLists.txt.
summary: Removes unreferenced functions, methods, constants, and template instantiations across Qt, netbase, policy, script, fuzzing, and kernel code. Enables the -Wunused-macros and -Wunused-template compiler warnings in CMake. This dead code cleanup is part of the incremental effort to enable -Wunused across the codebase.
